name: First Home
description: It has been said that the Goblins claim the great northern Spire is the home of their “missing deities,” and that Ascendants among them are vying for influence. Their effortless expulsion of the Saddlers’ incursions a century ago stands as evidence that gathering dangerous magic, fierce competition and hundreds of divine aspirants into one city leads to a hell of an army. Outsiders brave enough to venture within sight of the Spire clearly perceive a terrible power emanating from it, while the swarm of Goblins at its feet seems to grow with impossible speed…
